notes: Sequential baseline/candidate/baseline sweeps; each requests 1G, 4G, 21G and unlimited per direction. No live snapshots, local compilation, local kernel tests or Git packing during measurement. Separate-machine kernel tests ran concurrently.

Candidate retains elapsed pacing credit up to one existing total quantum. Outstanding reservations, congestion window, grant lifetime and PTO rules are unchanged. Unused reservations are not refunded.
Candidate is diagnostic only and was not adopted. The repeated baseline brackets scheduling variation; twenty-second observations establish no statistical confidence interval.
A full-quantum request still exhausts this bucket. This experiment does not rule out a bottleneck from recurrent owner scheduling delay.
Goodput excludes drain; missing fractions and counter deltas include drain. CPU100% means one core. Drop counters have different units and cannot be summed into exact frame loss.
No corrupt, duplicate, wrong-run or too-old inner records; no inner UDP errors, outer UDP errors, socket overflow or outer fragments. Reordering is reported.
